releaseNotes: Binge Hazmat 1.16.132 - New: Holiday layout (Settings > Layout): the Rows layout in Christmas colours, with falling snow, a string of lights and a festive name. New: the JAV menu has fourteen more sites, grouped as English / Translated to English / Previews, with English titles, thumbnails and descriptions. New: link Put.io and LinkSnappy under Settings > Premium Services; they are used for torrents (and LinkSnappy for hoster links). New: a film or episode that comes out today can be picked the same day: free sources list what they have straight away and torrents are listed only when your debrid service has them cached. Fixed: DaddyLive channels play again (12 of 12 tried, in about 4 seconds), and a game with many DaddyLive channels no longer waits 40 seconds for the slow ones.
